Version 5.0 is our biggest release in years. Most of the work went into speed, cleaner internals, and making the project easier to maintain over time.

## Node 16 is no longer supported

Node 16 has reached end-of-life, so version 5.0 requires Node 18 or later. Dropping it lets us use newer runtime features and remove old compatibility code.

## A faster router

We rewrote the routing engine from scratch. In our benchmarks it runs 2.3x faster than the old one. Apps with large or deeply nested route trees should see the biggest improvement in startup time and per-request overhead. You define routes the same way as before.

## Breaking changes

This release has 7 breaking changes. Most involve router configuration and middleware signatures, and a few deprecated APIs have been removed. The migration guide lists every change with before-and-after examples.

## Automated migration

A codemod handles most of the changes for you:

```
npx framework-codemod v5
```

Run it, review the diff, and then test your app. If you run into problems or have feedback, let us know on GitHub.
